messages.subject: matrixInput column and row names
parts:
Hi,

I updated to the latest versions of shiny (version 0.12.2) and shinyIncubator (version 0.2.2) today.

I liked the matrixInput() function that enables input of small sets of numbers. I have used this function with a previous version of these packages, and the column names of the data used to be displayed, which was nice. I find that the column names are no longer displayed with the latest version. Is there any way I can get to display the column names with matrixInput? Is it possible to display the row names as well?

Thanks for any help!

Jyothi
